earnings.title: FY2627 Q1 JAS 8-K EXHIBIT 99.1
highlights: CINCINNATI, October 22, 2026 - The Procter & Gamble Company (NYSE:PG) reported first quarter fiscal year 2027 net sales of $23.3 billion, an increase of four percent versus the prior year.
Diluted net earnings per share were $1.97, an increase of one percent versus prior year as the increase in net sales was partially offset by an increase in operating costs.
Core earnings per share were $2.00, an increase of one percent versus the prior year.
outlook: This outlook equates to a range of $6.89 to $7.11 per share, with a mid-point estimate of $7.00, or an increase of approximately one and a half percent.
P&G now expects a core effective tax rate to be in the range of 20% to 21% in fiscal 2027.
P&G continues to expect free cash flow productivity of 85% to 90% and expects to pay over $10 billion in dividends and to repurchase approximately $5 billion of common shares in fiscal 2027.
